name: stri_na2empty
title: Replace missing characters with empty strings

origin.description: Replaces every missing character with an empty string.
origin.details: A generalization is stri_replace_na, which can use a replacement other than the empty string. Other strings, including strings that are already empty, stay as they are.

translation.description: Replaces every missing character with an empty string.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, or a list of strings and stringi._na.NA. An integer or logical value is coerced to text.

translation.details: NA becomes "". An empty string stays empty. The string "NA" is not missing and is left unchanged. stri_replace_na is the same idea with a chosen replacement.
translation.example:
from stringi._na import NA
from stringi.utils import stri_na2empty
print(stri_na2empty(['a', NA, '', 'b']))
